repos.description: A modern GUI client based on Tauri, designed to run in Windows, macOS and Linux for tailored proxy experience
repos.summary_zh: Clash Verge Rev 是基于 Tauri 2 和 Rust 构建的现代化 Clash.Meta 客户端，支持跨平台（Windows/macOS/Linux），提供简洁美观的 GUI 界面、配置文件管理、TUN 模式、WebDav 同步及自定义主题，适用于高性能代理需求。
repos.summary_en: Clash Verge Rev is a modern GUI client for Clash.Meta (mihomo) built with Tauri 2 and Rust, offering cross-platform support (Windows, macOS, Linux), intuitive UI, config management, TUN mode, WebDav sync, and customizable themes for advanced proxy control.

repos.description: A cross-platform desktop All-in-One assistant for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Grok Build & Hermes Agent. Only official website: ccswitch.io
repos.summary_zh: 跨平台桌面一体化助手工具，支持 Claude Code、Codex 和 Gemini CLI 的统一管理，提供便捷的 AI 编程助手集成与配置，适用于多模型协作开发场景。
repos.summary_en: A cross-platform desktop all-in-one assistant tool for managing Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI, enabling unified configuration and integration of multiple AI coding assistants for streamlined development workflows.

repos.description:  This project is dedicated to collecting high-quality macOS software and organizing them systematically by different categories for easy search and use.
repos.summary_zh: Awesome Mac 是一个精选 macOS 优质软件的资源库，涵盖开发工具、设计软件、效率应用等多个类别。项目规模庞大，支持多语言（含中文、韩文），并提供 Docker 镜像和 npm 包形式发布。包含开源、免费、App Store 应用等标签分类，鼓励用户贡献与反馈。
repos.summary_en: Awesome Mac is a curated collection of premium macOS software across categories like development tools, design apps, and productivity utilities. It features a vast scale, multilingual support (including Chinese and Korean), and is available via Docker and npm. The list categorizes apps by open-source, freeware, and App Store status, encouraging community contributions.

repos.description: 🎨 Best DeepSeek Harness Design Plugin. The open-source Claude Design alternative. 🖥️ Local-first desktop app. 🖼️ Your coding agent becomes the design engine: prototypes, landing pages, dashboards, slides, images & video — real files, HTML/PDF/PPTX/MP4 export. 🤖 Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / DeepSeek Harness / OpenCode & 20+ CLIs via BYOK.
repos.summary_zh: Open Design 是一个本地优先、开源的 Claude Design 替代方案，支持 13 种主流编码代理 CLI（如 Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等），通过 31 个可组合技能和 72 套品牌级设计系统，生成网页、桌面、移动端原型、幻灯片、图像、视频及 HyperFrames，支持沙盒预览与多格式导出（HTML/PDF/PPTX/MP4），并可完全自托管。
repos.summary_en: Open Design is a local-first, open-source alternative to Anthropic's Claude Design, integrating 13 coding-agent CLIs (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) with 31 composable skills and 72 brand-grade design systems to generate web, desktop, mobile prototypes, slides, images, videos, and HyperFrames, offering sandboxed preview and export to HTML/PDF/PPTX/MP4.

repos.description: Playwright is a framework for Web Testing and Automation. It allows testing Chromium, Firefox and WebKit with a single API.
repos.summary_zh: Playwright 是一个现代化的 Web 测试与自动化框架，支持 Chromium、Firefox 和 WebKit 三大浏览器内核的统一 API 调用。其核心优势在于内置智能等待机制、原生支持跨浏览器测试、无人工超时设计，以及自动生成测试追踪与录屏功能，显著提升端到端测试的稳定性与效率。
repos.summary_en: Playwright is a modern framework for web testing and automation that provides a single API to test Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit browsers. It features built-in auto-waiting, cross-browser support, no artificial timeouts, and native tracing/video capture, making end-to-end tests more reliable and efficient.

repos.description: Stop renting your intelligence. Own it with AnythingLLM. Everything you need for a powerful local-first agent experience
repos.summary_zh: AnythingLLM 是一款全栈式桌面与 Docker AI 应用，集成 RAG、AI 智能体、无代码智能体构建器及 MCP 兼容性，支持多用户管理与权限控制，提供灵活 LLM 与向量数据库配置，实现文档智能对话与自动化处理。
repos.summary_en: AnythingLLM is a full-stack desktop and Docker-based AI application featuring built-in RAG, AI agents, no-code agent builder, and MCP compatibility. It supports customizable LLMs and vector databases, multi-user management, and seamless document interaction for intelligent chat and automation.

repos.description: :atom: The hackable text editor
repos.summary_zh: Atom 是一款基于 Electron 构建的现代化可定制文本编辑器，专为 21 世纪开发者设计。它融合了经典编辑器的优点，支持深度自定义但默认配置友好易用，适用于跨平台开发环境。
repos.summary_en: Atom is a hackable, modern text editor built on Electron, designed for deep customization while remaining approachable. It combines the best features of traditional editors with a flexible, open-source architecture for developers.

repos.description: A full-featured download manager.
repos.summary_zh: Motrix 是一款现代化全功能下载管理器，支持 HTTP、FTP、BitTorrent 及磁力链接。v2 基于 Electron+React+TypeScript 重构，采用 MDXP 协议实现浏览器扩展与 CLI 远程控制，支持 Docker 无头服务器部署，适用于桌面与 NAS/家庭服务器场景。
repos.summary_en: Motrix is a modern, full-featured download manager supporting HTTP, FTP, BitTorrent, and magnet links. v2 is rebuilt with Electron, React, and TypeScript, using the MDXP protocol for browser extensions and CLI remote control. It supports Docker headless deployment, ideal for desktop and NAS/home server scenarios.

repos.description: Create stunning demos for free. Open-source, no subscriptions, no watermarks, and free for commercial use. An alternative to Screen Studio.
repos.summary_zh: OpenScreen 是一款免费开源的屏幕录制工具，提供无广告、无订阅、商业可用的屏幕录制与编辑功能，支持自定义缩放、背景、注释及导出设置，适用于制作产品演示和教程视频，是 Screen Studio 的轻量级替代方案。
repos.summary_en: OpenScreen is a free, open-source screen recording tool offering watermark-free, subscription-free recordings with customizable zooms, backgrounds, annotations, and export options. Ideal for product demos and tutorials, it serves as a lightweight alternative to Screen Studio.

repos.description: A free, open source, and extensible speech-to-text application that works completely offline.
repos.summary_zh: Handy 是一款免费开源的离线语音转文字桌面应用，基于 Whisper 和 Parakeet 模型实现本地语音识别，支持全局快捷键录音、VAD 降噪及多平台运行，注重隐私保护且高度可扩展。
repos.summary_en: Handy is a free, open-source, offline speech-to-text desktop app powered by Whisper and Parakeet models. It offers local transcription with VAD, global hotkeys, and cross-platform support, prioritizing privacy and extensibility.

repos.description: Create polished demo videos without editing skills. Mac/Windows/Linux
repos.summary_zh: Recordly 是一款开源的跨平台屏幕录制与编辑工具，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。它无需后期剪辑即可生成专业级演示视频，内置自动缩放、光标美化、动态摄像头气泡叠加、时间轴编辑及扩展市场等功能，专为教程、产品演示等场景优化，显著提升录制效率与视觉表现。
repos.summary_en: Recordly is an open-source, cross-platform screen recorder and editor for macOS, Windows, and Linux. It enables polished screen recordings without post-editing by offering auto-zooms, cursor enhancements, dynamic webcam overlays, timeline editing, and a community extension marketplace—ideal for demos, walkthroughs, and product videos.

repos.description: Professional Antigravity Account Manager & Switcher. One-click seamless account switching for Antigravity Tools. Built with Tauri v2 + React (Rust).专业的 Antigravity 账号管理与切换工具。为 Antigravity 提供一键无缝账号切换功能。
repos.summary_zh: Antigravity-Manager 是一款专业的 AI 账号管理与协议代理系统，基于 Tauri v2 + Rust + React 构建。提供多账号无缝切换、OAuth 2.0 授权、智能配额监控、协议转换（OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini）、模型路由与后台任务静默降级等核心功能，打造高性能本地 AI 中转网关。
repos.summary_en: Antigravity-Manager is a professional AI account management and protocol proxy system built with Tauri v2 + Rust + React. It enables seamless multi-account switching, OAuth 2.0 authorization, intelligent quota monitoring, protocol conversion (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini), model routing, and silent background task fallback, serving as a high-performance local AI proxy gateway.

repos.description: :electron: Another Mihomo GUI.
repos.summary_zh: Clash Party 是一款基于 Electron 的 Mihomo（Clash Meta）图形界面客户端，提供开箱即用的代理管理工具。支持 Smart Core 智能节点选择、多主题 UI、WebDAV 配置备份、Sub-Store 订阅集成及内核切换，简化了复杂代理配置流程，适合需要高效网络代理的用户。
repos.summary_en: Clash Party is an Electron-based GUI for Mihomo (Clash Meta) that offers an out-of-the-box proxy management tool. It features Smart Core AI-driven node selection, multi-theme UI, WebDAV config backup, Sub-Store integration, and dual-core support, streamlining complex proxy configurations for end users.

repos.description: Happy is the open-source desktop app for Claude Code, Codex, and Grok, with an iOS and Android app to control your coding agents from anywhere.
repos.summary_zh: Happy Coder 是一款移动端和网页端客户端，支持 Claude Code 和 Codex，具备端到端加密、实时语音交互及全功能远程控制。用户可通过手机或网页随时监控 AI 编码进度，实现设备间无缝切换，保障代码安全。
repos.summary_en: Happy Coder is a mobile and web client for Claude Code and Codex, featuring end-to-end encryption, real-time voice, and full-featured remote control. It enables users to monitor AI coding progress from any device, switch sessions instantly, and ensures code privacy with zero telemetry.

repos.description: MagicMirror² is an open source modular smart mirror platform. With a growing list of installable modules, the MagicMirror² allows you to convert your hallway or bathroom mirror into your personal assistant.
repos.summary_zh: MagicMirror² 是一款开源模块化智能镜平台，可将走廊或浴室镜子转换为个人助手。基于 Electron 构建，无需服务器或浏览器，支持大量可安装插件，提供天气、日历、新闻等实时信息展示，适用于智能家居场景。
repos.summary_en: MagicMirror² is an open source modular smart mirror platform that transforms hallways or bathroom mirrors into personal assistants. Built with Electron, it requires no web server or browser, supports numerous installable modules for displaying real-time info like weather, calendar, and news in smart home environments.

repos.description: 🐱 BongoCat — A cross-platform interactive desktop pet that brings fun to your desktop!
repos.summary_zh: BongoCat 是一款跨平台互动桌宠应用，基于 Tauri 框架开发，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 系统。它以可爱的猫咪形象提供桌面陪伴功能，用户可通过点击、拖拽等交互触发趣味动画，为日常办公增添轻松娱乐元素。
repos.summary_en: BongoCat is a cross-platform interactive desktop pet built with Tauri, supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux. It features a playful cat character that responds to user interactions like clicks and drags with animated effects, adding entertainment to your desktop experience.

repos.description: Open source Loom alternative. Beautiful, shareable screen recordings.
repos.summary_zh: Cap 是一款开源的 Loom 替代工具，提供美观、可分享的屏幕录制功能。支持视频录制、编辑与快速分享，采用 Rust + Tauri 构建桌面端，Next.js + React 开发 Web 端，基于 MySQL 和 Drizzle ORM，支持 Docker 一键部署与自托管。
repos.summary_en: Cap is an open-source alternative to Loom, offering beautiful, shareable screen recordings. It enables quick video recording, editing, and sharing via a desktop app (Tauri/Rust) and web interface (Next.js/React), with MySQL backend, Docker deployment, and self-hosting support.

repos.description: 🐱 🧸跨平台互动桌宠 BongoCat，为桌面增添乐趣！
repos.summary_zh: BongoCat是一款跨平台互动桌宠应用，支持Windows、macOS和Linux。猫咪会在桌面上自由行走、互动，为桌面增添趣味与陪伴感。项目正从Tauri迁移至C/C++、SDL3和OpenGL的原生实现，轻量高效，适合个性化桌面装饰与解压场景。
repos.summary_en: BongoCat is a cross-platform interactive desktop pet app supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux. The cat wanders and interacts on your desktop, adding fun and companionship. Migrating from Tauri to a native C/C++ + SDL3 + OpenGL implementation for better performance, ideal for desktop personalization and stress relief.

repos.description: A powerful GUI app and Toolkit for Claude Code - Create custom agents, manage interactive Claude Code sessions, run secure background agents, and more.
repos.summary_zh: opcode 是一款基于 Tauri 2 的 Claude Code GUI 工具，提供项目与会话管理、自定义 AI 代理创建、MCP 服务器集成、使用量分析仪表板等功能，将命令行工具转化为直观的桌面应用，提升 AI 辅助开发效率。
repos.summary_en: opcode is a powerful desktop GUI app built with Tauri 2 for Claude Code, enabling custom agent creation, interactive session management, MCP server integration, usage analytics, and secure background agent execution to enhance AI-assisted development productivity.

repos.description: 🌈一个跨平台的划词翻译和OCR软件 | A cross-platform software for text translation and recognition.
repos.summary_zh: Pot 是一款跨平台划词翻译与 OCR 软件，支持 Windows/macOS/Linux 及 Wayland 环境，集成 OpenAI、Google、DeepL 等 20+ 翻译接口，提供多接口并行翻译、语音合成、生词本导出等功能，具备插件系统和外部调用能力，界面简洁高效。
repos.summary_en: Pot is a cross-platform software for text translation and OCR, supporting Windows/macOS/Linux and Wayland. It integrates 20+ translation APIs including OpenAI, Google, and DeepL, offering parallel translation, speech synthesis, vocabulary export, plugin system, and external call functionality with a clean interface.

repos.description: 一个第三方音乐播放器、本地服务、桌面歌词、音乐下载、远程控制
repos.summary_zh: AlgerMusicPlayer 是一款功能强大的第三方跨平台音乐播放器，支持网易云账号登录、本地服务、桌面歌词、音乐下载及远程控制。基于 Electron 和 Vue 开发，提供沉浸式歌词显示、EQ均衡器、多语言界面和明暗主题切换，支持全平台运行（桌面/Web/移动端），兼顾高品质音质与个性化体验。
repos.summary_en: AlgerMusicPlayer is a powerful third-party cross-platform music player supporting NetEase Cloud login, local services, desktop lyrics, music downloads, and remote control. Built with Electron and Vue, it offers immersive lyrics, EQ equalizer, multi-language UI, dark/light themes, and high-fidelity audio, running on Desktop, Web, and Mobile platforms with personalized features.

repos.description: This repository is outdated and new Boost Note app is available! We've launched a new Boost Note app which supports real-time collaborative writing. https://github.com/BoostIO/BoostNote-App
repos.summary_zh: BoostNote-Legacy 是一款面向程序员的开源笔记应用，支持多平台（Mac、Windows、Linux）。该仓库已标记为过时，推荐使用支持实时协作的新版 BoostNote 应用，其基于 Electron、React + Redux 构建，提供跨平台桌面与移动端支持。
repos.summary_en: BoostNote-Legacy is an open-source note-taking app designed for programmers, supporting Mac, Windows, and Linux. This repository is deprecated; users are advised to migrate to the new BoostNote app, which features real-time collaborative writing and is built with Electron, React + Redux.

repos.description: Free and open-source macOS menu bar toolkit.
repos.summary_zh: Vorssaint 是一款免费开源的 macOS 菜单栏工具集，以单一图标整合音量混音、系统监控、窗口管理、剪贴板历史、文本片段等多项实用功能。模块化设计支持按需安装卸载，零账户、零遥测、零订阅，专为用户隐私和性能效率而构建。
repos.summary_en: Vorssaint is a free, open-source macOS menu bar toolkit that consolidates volume mixing, system monitoring, window management, clipboard history, and more into a single lightweight icon. Fully modular, privacy-first with zero telemetry or subscriptions, and requires macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon.

repos.description: Codex Dream Skin
repos.summary_zh: Codex Dream Skin 是一款针对 OpenAI Codex 桌面端的跨平台换肤工具。它通过本机回环 CDP 注入技术，在不修改官方安装包与代码签名的前提下，实现对侧栏、输入框等原生控件的主题化定制。支持一键换图与还原，兼顾个性化氛围感与系统安全性。
repos.summary_en: Codex Dream Skin is a cross-platform theming tool for the OpenAI Codex desktop app. Utilizing local loopback CDP injection, it customizes native UI elements like sidebars and input boxes without altering the official installation package or code signature. It supports one-click image swapping and restoration, balancing personalized aesthetics with system security.

repos.description: Make Any Website & Tool Your CLI. A universal CLI Hub and AI-native runtime. Transform any website, Electron app, or local binary into a standardized command-line interface. Built for AI Agents to discover, learn, and execute tools seamlessly via a unified AGENT.md integration.
repos.summary_zh: OpenCLI 是一个强大的 AI 原生浏览器自动化工具，可将任意网站或 Electron 应用转换为命令行接口。它支持会话复用、AI 驱动的发现与合成，提供零风险的数据提取和跨平台自动化能力，适用于 Bilibili、知乎、小红书等主流平台。
repos.summary_en: OpenCLI is a powerful, AI-native browser automation tool that turns any website or Electron app into a CLI. It enables seamless web data extraction and automation with session reuse, AI-powered discovery, and dynamic adapter loading, supporting platforms like Bilibili, Zhihu, and Xiaohongshu.

repos.description: :speech_balloon: A better WeChat on macOS and Linux. Built with Electron by Zhongyi Tong.
repos.summary_zh: Electronic WeChat 是一款基于 Electron 开发的跨平台微信客户端，专为 macOS 和 Linux 设计。它复刻了网页版微信的所有功能，包括消息撤回拦截、表情包支持、拖拽发送图片等，并优化了原生应用体验。项目已停止维护，但作为 Electron 桌面应用开发的优秀范例仍具参考价值。
repos.summary_en: Electronic WeChat is an Electron-based cross-platform WeChat client for macOS and Linux, replicating all Web WeChat features including message recall blocking and sticker support. It offers native-like experience with optimizations like direct URL access and drag-and-drop file sharing. Though discontinued, it serves as an excellent reference for Electron desktop app development.

repos.description: :speech_balloon: A better WeChat on macOS and Linux. Built with Electron by Zhongyi Tong.
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个基于 Electron 开发的跨平台微信客户端，支持 macOS 和 Linux，提供现代化界面和完整 Web 微信功能，包括消息撤回拦截、贴图支持、文件拖拽发送等。项目已停止维护，作为技术存档供学习参考。
repos.summary_en: An Electron-based cross-platform WeChat client for macOS and Linux, featuring modern UI, full Web WeChat functionality, message recall blocking, sticker support, and drag-and-drop file sharing. The project is archived and no longer actively maintained.

repos.description: Clash Nyanpasu～(∠・ω< )⌒☆​
repos.summary_zh: Clash Nyanpasu 是一款基于 Tauri 框架的 Clash 网络代理图形界面客户端，支持 Clash Premium、Mihomo 和 Clash Rust 内核。提供多配置文件和 Provider 管理功能，采用 Google Material You 设计语言，具备深色/浅色主题切换，支持跨平台运行。
repos.summary_en: Clash Nyanpasu is a Tauri-based GUI client for Clash network proxy, supporting Clash Premium, Mihomo, and Clash Rust cores. It offers profile and provider management with Google Material You UI design, dark/light themes, and cross-platform support.

repos.description: [deprecated in favor of https://microsoft.github.io/react-native-windows/] React Native for macOS is an experimental fork for writing desktop apps using Cocoa
repos.summary_zh: React Native macOS 是一个实验性分支，允许使用 React Native 和 Cocoa 构建 macOS 桌面应用。该项目已停止维护，推荐迁移至微软官方支持的 React Native Windows 或利用 Catalyst 技术运行。
repos.summary_en: React Native for macOS was an experimental fork enabling desktop app development using React Native and Cocoa. The project is now deprecated and no longer maintained, with Microsoft's React Native Windows recommended as the successor.

repos.description: 一款以电影镜头、粒子视觉和歌词舞台为核心的沉浸式音乐播放器。
repos.summary_zh: Mineradio 是一款基于 Electron 的 Windows 桌面沉浸式音乐播放器，融合电影镜头视觉、粒子动画与歌词舞台，打造私人音乐空间。支持网易云/QQ音乐接入、3D歌单架、自定义封面与本地 MP4 播放，项目当前长期停更。
repos.summary_en: Mineradio is an Electron-based Windows desktop immersive music player featuring cinematic visual effects, particle animations, and lyrics stage. It integrates NetEase/QQ Music APIs, 3D playlist browsing, and custom cover support. The project is currently archived.

repos.description: 一款以电影镜头、粒子视觉和歌词舞台为核心的沉浸式音乐播放器。
repos.summary_zh: Mineradio 是一款基于 Electron 的 Windows 桌面沉浸式音乐播放器，深度融合电影级镜头、粒子视觉与歌词舞台。它集成了 Open-Meteo 天气电台、网易云/QQ 音乐多平台接入及 3D 歌单架，通过节奏驱动的视觉系统为用户打造极具现场感的私人音乐空间。
repos.summary_en: Mineradio is an Electron-based Windows desktop immersive music player that deeply integrates cinematic camera effects, particle visuals, and lyric stages. Featuring Open-Meteo weather radio, multi-platform music integration (NetEase/QQ), and a 3D playlist shelf, it creates a highly engaging private music space driven by rhythm-based visual systems.

repos.description: ✍️ A static blog writing client (一个静态博客写作客户端)
repos.summary_zh: Gridea 是一款跨平台静态博客写作客户端，支持 Markdown 编辑、多语言界面、主题定制及 Gitalk/DisqusJS 评论系统。用户可本地创作并一键发布至 GitHub Pages 等平台，集成 OneDrive/iCloud 实现多设备同步，适合个人知识管理与内容创作。
repos.summary_en: Gridea is a cross-platform static blog writing client that supports Markdown editing, multi-language interface, theme customization, and Gitalk/DisqusJS comment systems. It enables local content creation with one-click publishing to platforms like GitHub Pages, featuring OneDrive/iCloud sync for multi-device workflows, ideal for personal knowledge management and content creation.

repos.description: A modern self-hosted music player.
repos.summary_zh: Feishin 是一款现代化的自托管音乐播放器，支持 MPV 和 Web 播放器后端，提供现代化 UI、智能播放列表编辑、歌词同步与反同步功能，并支持将播放记录同步至服务器，适用于个人音乐库管理与流媒体播放。
repos.summary_en: Feishin is a modern self-hosted music player featuring MPV and web player backends, a sleek UI, smart playlist editing, synchronized lyrics, and playback scrobbling to your server, ideal for managing personal music libraries and streaming.

repos.description: 微信视频号下载器
repos.summary_zh: 微信视频号下载器是一款轻量级跨平台工具，支持 Windows 和 macOS 系统，通过注入浏览器扩展实现一键下载视频号视频。无需登录或复杂配置，自动安装证书并启动代理服务，在微信 PC 端界面直接添加下载按钮，支持多画质选择，下载完成后自动展示文件信息，体积小巧且操作简便。
repos.summary_en: WeChat Channels Video Downloader is a lightweight cross-platform tool for Windows and macOS that enables one-click downloading of videos from WeChat Channels. It automatically installs certificates, starts a proxy service, and injects download buttons into the WeChat PC client interface. Users can select video quality (e.g., xWT111, xWT98) and download files with metadata displayed post-download, offering a simple and efficient experience.

repos.description: 插件化、定制化、无广告的免费音乐播放器
repos.summary_zh: MusicFree 桌面版是一款插件化、无广告的免费音乐播放器，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。其核心特性包括：通过插件机制接入任意音源（如搜索、播放、歌单导入），高度定制化主题系统（支持 CSS 变量与 iframe 背景），以及本地数据存储保障隐私。用户可自由扩展音源与界面风格，实现个性化音乐体验。
repos.summary_en: MusicFree Desktop is a plugin-based, ad-free, open-source music player supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux. Key features include: plugin-driven access to any audio source (search, playback, playlist import), highly customizable themes via CSS variables and iframe backgrounds, and local data storage for privacy. Users can extend sources and personalize UI freely.

repos.description: 网易云音乐第三方
repos.summary_zh: ieaseMusic 是一款基于 Electron、React 和 MobX 构建的优雅网易云音乐第三方桌面客户端，支持跨平台（macOS/Linux/Windows）、高音质（FLAC）、键盘操作、桌面通知、Last.fm 听歌记录同步、多平台音源修复（如 QQ 音乐、虾米等）、社交分享及微信扫码登录，集成 Alfred 3 工作流，提供现代化 UI 与下载功能。
repos.summary_en: ieaseMusic is an elegant third-party Netease Music desktop app built with Electron, React, and MobX. It supports cross-platform use (macOS/Linux/Windows), high-quality FLAC audio, keyboard shortcuts, desktop notifications, Last.fm scrobbling, multi-source link fixing (e.g., QQ, Xiami), social sharing, WeChat login, and includes an Alfred 3 workflow for quick access.

repos.description: Windows版本微信客户端（非网页版）自动化，可实现简单的发送、接收微信消息，简单微信机器人
repos.summary_zh: wxauto 是一个基于 Windows 平台、使用 UIAutomation 技术实现的微信客户端自动化工具，支持消息发送与接收，适用于开发简单微信机器人的场景。项目于2025年10月28日停止维护，仅支持微信3.9.x版本及Windows 10/11或Server 2016+系统。
repos.summary_en: wxauto is a Windows-based automation tool for the WeChat desktop client (non-web version) using UIAutomation technology. It enables basic message sending and receiving, suitable for building simple WeChat bots. The project was discontinued on October 28, 2025, supporting WeChat 3.9.x and Windows 10/11 or Server 2016+. It is intended solely for technical learning and not for production or illegal use.

repos.summary_zh: Craft Agents 是一款基于 Agent Native 理念构建的开源桌面应用，支持通过自然语言连接任意 API、MCP 服务或本地工具（如 Slack、Linear、PostgreSQL），无需配置文件。它集成 Claude 与 Pi SDK，提供多会话管理、实时技能扩展和文档导向的工作流，所有操作均可通过提示词即时完成，专为高效人机协作设计。
repos.summary_en: Craft Agents is an open-source desktop application built on Agent Native principles, enabling natural language integration with any API, MCP server, or local tool (e.g., Slack, Linear, PostgreSQL) without config files. It combines Claude and Pi SDKs, offering multi-session management, real-time skill expansion, and a document-centric workflow—all customizable via prompts for seamless human-agent collaboration.

repos.description: "Sigma File Manager" is a free, open-source, quickly evolving, modern file manager (explorer / browser) app for Windows and Linux.
repos.summary_zh: Sigma File Manager 是一款免费开源的现代文件管理器，专为 Windows 和 Linux 设计，支持快速文件浏览与操作。项目已进入 v2 稳定测试阶段，提供直观界面与高效功能，适用于日常文件管理需求。
repos.summary_en: Sigma File Manager is a free, open-source, modern file manager for Windows and Linux, offering fast file browsing and operations. Now in v2 beta, it features an intuitive interface and efficient tools for streamlined file management.

repos.description: Local-first AI coding agent desktop: Electron + Rust host core + pi Agent Harness + user-installable plugins
repos.summary_zh: PI-Desktop是一款本地优先的AI编程代理桌面应用，采用Electron + Rust架构。支持OpenAI、Anthropic及自定义模型，提供Agent/Plan/Goal三种协作模式，内置权限审查层与可扩展插件系统，实现跨平台独立编码工作空间。
repos.summary_en: PI-Desktop is a local-first AI coding agent desktop app built with Electron and Rust. It supports OpenAI, Anthropic, and custom models, offers Agent/Plan/Goal modes with permission controls and an extensible plugin system for cross-platform independent coding workspaces.

repos.description: A multi-model AI agent desktop client — connect any AI provider, extend with MCP & skills, control from your phone. Built with Electron + Next.js.
repos.summary_zh: CodePilot 是一个基于 Electron + Next.js 构建的 Claude Code 桌面 GUI 客户端，提供多模型提供商支持、MCP 扩展、自定义技能、跨平台通信及项目感知型智能助手工作区，实现可视化聊天、编码与项目管理一体化体验。
repos.summary_en: CodePilot is a desktop GUI client for Claude Code built with Electron and Next.js, offering multi-provider support, MCP extensions, custom skills, cross-platform bridging, and an AI assistant workspace that understands your projects through persistent memory and onboarding flows.

repos.description: 🐬DeepChat - A smart assistant that connects powerful AI to your personal world
repos.summary_zh: DeepChat 是一个功能丰富的开源 AI 智能体平台，统一整合模型、工具和智能体，支持多 LLM 对话、MCP 工具调用和 ACP 智能体集成，提供强大的桌面端 AI 助手体验。
repos.summary_en: DeepChat is a powerful open-source AI agent platform that unifies models, tools, and agents, offering multi-LLM chat, MCP tool calling, and ACP agent integration for seamless desktop AI assistance.

repos.description: Free and open source database client built natively for developers
repos.summary_zh: TablePro 是一款面向开发者的免费开源原生数据库客户端，支持 macOS、iOS 和 Linux。它摒弃 Electron 和 JVM，采用原生框架构建，冷启动低于 1 秒，内存占用约 80MB。支持 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQLite、Redis 等主流 SQL/NoSQL 数据库，内置 AI 功能（聊天、代码建议、MCP 服务），并可通过插件扩展。提供 SQL 编辑器、数据网格、SSH 隧道、iCloud 同步等核心功能，是 TablePlus 的开源替代方案。
repos.summary_en: TablePro is a free, open-source native database client for developers, built without Electron or JVM. It supports major SQL and NoSQL databases with native drivers, cold starts under 1 second, and ~80MB RAM usage. Features include an AI-powered SQL editor, data grid, SSH tunnels, iCloud sync, and plugin extensibility. It serves as an open-source alternative to TablePlus with integrated AI chat, MCP server, and cross-platform support.

repos.description: One Remote Access Manager to Rule Them All
repos.summary_zh: 1Remote 是一款现代化的个人远程会话管理与启动工具，支持 RDP、SSH、VNC、Telnet、(S)FTP 等多种协议，提供多屏幕 HiDPI 连接、标签化界面、自定义运行器及 mRemoteNG 导入功能，支持便携运行与多语言主题定制。
repos.summary_en: 1Remote is a modern personal remote session manager and launcher supporting RDP, SSH, VNC, Telnet, (S)FTP, RemoteApp, NoMachine and more. It offers multi-screen HiDPI RDP support, customizable runners, mRemoteNG import, portable deployment, and a tabbed, multi-language interface.

repos.summary_zh: Craft Agents 是一款基于 Agent Native 理念构建的开源桌面应用，支持通过自然语言连接任意 API、MCP 服务或本地工具（如 Linear、Gmail、Slack、PostgreSQL 等），无需配置文件。它集成 Claude 与 Pi SDK，提供多会话管理、实时技能扩展和文档中心化工作流，用户仅需描述需求即可自动完成集成与任务执行。
repos.summary_en: Craft Agents is an open-source desktop application built on Agent Native principles, enabling natural language integration with any API, MCP service, or local tool (e.g., Linear, Gmail, Slack, PostgreSQL) without config files. It combines Claude and Pi SDKs to offer multi-session management, real-time skill expansion, and a document-centric workflow—users simply describe what they want, and the agent handles execution.

repos.description: A lightweight desktop app to manage, sync, and organize AI agent skills across 50+ coding tools — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, and more.
repos.summary_zh: Skills Manager 是一款轻量级桌面应用，用于统一管理、同步和组织 AI 智能体技能，支持 15+ 主流开发工具（如 Cursor、Claude Code、GitHub Copilot 等）。通过中央仓库集中管理技能，支持从 Git 仓库、本地文件或市场导入，一键同步至目标工具，并提供场景分组、更新追踪和技能文档预览功能。
repos.summary_en: Skills Manager is a lightweight desktop app that centralizes the management, sync, and organization of AI agent skills across 15+ coding tools like Cursor, Claude Code, and GitHub Copilot. It supports importing skills from Git repos, local folders, or the marketplace into a unified repository, enables one-click sync via symlinks/copies, and offers scenario grouping, update tracking, and in-app skill documentation preview.

repos.description: 💬 Unofficial WeChat client built with React, MobX and Electron.
repos.summary_zh: weweChat 是基于 React、MobX 和 Electron 开发的非官方微信客户端，支持桌面端多平台运行，具备消息防撤回、桌面通知、键盘快捷键、拖拽发送文件、批量消息发送等实用功能，界面现代化且兼容 macOS 窗口毛玻璃效果。
repos.summary_en: weweChat is an unofficial WeChat desktop client built with React, MobX, and Electron. It supports desktop notifications, message recall blocking, keyboard shortcuts, drag-and-drop file sending, and batch messaging, offering a modern interface with macOS vibrancy effects.

repos.description: Postcat 是一个可扩展的 API 工具平台。集合基础的 API 管理和测试功能，并且可以通过插件简化你的 API 开发工作，让你可以更快更好地创建 API。An extensible API tool.
repos.summary_zh: Postcat 是一个开源、跨平台的 API 开发测试工具，支持 REST 和 WebSocket 协议，具备 API 管理、测试、Mock 及团队协作功能。通过插件系统实现功能扩展，提供多语言界面与自定义主题，适用于中小团队快速构建和验证 API。
repos.summary_en: Postcat is an open-source, cross-platform API development and testing tool supporting REST and WebSocket protocols. It offers API management, testing, Mock, team collaboration, and extensibility via plugins. With customizable themes and multi-language support, it enables efficient API creation and validation for small to medium teams.

repos.description: 👻 A simple & beautiful GUI application for scrcpy.
repos.summary_zh: Scrcpy GUI 是一个简洁美观的图形界面应用，用于便捷控制 Android 设备屏幕。它基于 scrcpy 实现，支持 USB 和无线连接、实时屏幕镜像、键盘鼠标控制、多设备管理、剪贴板共享等功能，无需 Root，跨平台运行，提升手机操作效率。
repos.summary_en: Scrcpy GUI is a simple and beautiful graphical application for controlling Android devices via scrcpy. It supports USB and wireless connections, real-time screen mirroring, keyboard/mouse input, multi-device management, clipboard sharing, and more—without requiring root access. It enhances mobile productivity across Windows, macOS, and Linux.

repos.description: Collaborative multi-agent AI coding workspace: aggregate sessions from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Grok Build, etc. Desktop app, self-hosted server, or Docker.
repos.summary_zh: Codeg是一款协作式多智能体AI编码工作空间，统一整合Claude Code、Codex、Grok等15+主流AI编程代理。提供桌面应用、自托管服务及Docker部署方案，支持跨平台使用。核心特性包括会话跨代理迁移、任务委托协作、统一对话界面，大幅降低多代理协作门槛。
repos.summary_en: Codeg is a collaborative multi-agent AI coding workspace unifying 15+ AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Grok. Supports desktop, self-hosted, and Docker deployments across all platforms. Key features include session migration between agents, collaborative task delegation via @mentions, and a unified conversation interface.

repos.description: Collaborative multi-agent AI coding workspace: aggregate sessions from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Grok Build, etc. Desktop app, self-hosted server, or Docker.
repos.summary_zh: Codeg 是一个企业级多智能体编码工作台，统一集成 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等本地 AI 编程助手。支持桌面应用、独立服务器或 Docker 部署，提供浏览器远程访问。核心功能包括对话聚合、Git worktree 并行开发、MCP/Skills 管理、Telegram/Lark 等聊天渠道集成及终端集成，实现全链路工程化开发流程。
repos.summary_en: Codeg is an enterprise-grade multi-agent coding workspace that unifies local AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, etc.) in a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker container. It enables remote development via any browser with conversation aggregation, parallel git worktree workflows, MCP/Skills management, chat channel integration (Telegram, Lark, iLink), and integrated terminal/file/Git workflows.

repos.description: Record your screen, ship a demo. Free and open-source, GPU-accelerated, no watermarks, no subscriptions. Windows, macOS, Linux. Actively maintained.
repos.summary_zh: OpenScreen 是一款免费开源的屏幕录制与演示制作工具，作为 Screen Studio 的开源替代方案。支持窗口/全屏录制、自动缩放、光标特效、摄像头画中画、本地 AI 字幕生成及 AI 编辑助手，适用于产品演示、教程视频和社交媒体内容创作，支持 macOS/Windows/Linux 跨平台使用。
repos.summary_en: OpenScreen is a free, open-source screen recording and demo creation tool, positioned as an alternative to Screen Studio. It features window/full-screen recording, auto-zooms, cursor effects, webcam overlay, on-device AI captions, and an AI editing assistant. Ideal for product demos, tutorials, and social media content across macOS, Windows, and Linux.

repos.description: Enhanced MCP server for interactive user feedback and command execution in AI-assisted development, featuring dual interface support (Web UI and Desktop Application) with intelligent environment detection and cross-platform compatibility.
repos.summary_zh: MCP Feedback Enhanced 是一个增强型 MCP 服务器，专为 AI 辅助开发设计，支持 Web UI 和跨平台桌面应用双界面，具备智能环境检测与反馈驱动工作流，可显著降低平台成本并提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: MCP Feedback Enhanced is an enhanced MCP server designed for AI-assisted development, featuring dual interface support (Web UI and cross-platform desktop app) with intelligent environment detection and feedback-driven workflows to reduce platform costs and boost development efficiency.

repos.description: Hold a key, speak, release — AI-polished text appears at your cursor in any app. Open-source voice input for macOS & Windows. (按住快捷键说话，松开即得润色后的文字)
repos.summary_zh: OpenLess 是一款开源的跨平台语音输入工具，支持 macOS 和 Windows。用户按住快捷键说话，松开后即可获得 AI 润色后的文本，并自动插入光标位置或复制到剪贴板。其核心亮点是 AI 提示模式，能将口语化表达转化为结构清晰、上下文丰富的提示词，适用于 ChatGPT、Claude 等 AI 工具，提升输入效率。
repos.summary_en: OpenLess is an open-source, cross-platform voice input app for macOS and Windows. Press a hotkey, speak naturally, and get AI-polished text inserted at your cursor or copied to clipboard. Its standout feature is AI-prompt mode, which transforms rambling speech into structured, context-rich prompts ready for use in ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools.

repos.description: macOS Adobe apps download & installer
repos.summary_zh: Adobe Downloader 是一款专为 macOS 设计的 Adobe 应用程序下载与安装工具，支持多产品并行下载、版本与语言选择，并集成自动化安装与清理功能。通过内置 Helper 机制实现免密操作，无需用户干预即可完成 Setup 组件修改，确保合法官方渠道下载，适用于专业创意软件部署。
repos.summary_en: Adobe Downloader is a macOS-native tool for downloading and installing Adobe applications. It supports parallel downloads, version/language selection, and automated installation via a built-in Helper mechanism that eliminates password prompts. All downloads are from official Adobe sources, with full cleanup utilities for residual files, ideal for enterprise or personal use.

repos.description: Auto-register & manage accounts for ChatGPT, Cursor, Kiro, Grok, Windsurf, Trae & 13+ AI platforms · Protocol/browser dual-mode · Plugin-based · One-click Mac/Windows desktop app
repos.summary_zh: Any Auto Register 是一个多平台账号自动注册与管理系统，支持 Trae.ai、Tavily、Cursor 等主流 AI 平台。采用 FastAPI + React 架构，具备插件化扩展能力，集成邮箱服务（MoeMail/Laoudo/DuckMail）、验证码识别（YesCaptcha/2Captcha/Camoufox）及代理池管理功能，提供实时日志推送的 Web UI 界面。
repos.summary_en: Any Auto Register is a multi-platform account auto-registration and management system supporting major AI platforms like Trae.ai, Tavily, and Cursor. Built with FastAPI + React, it features plugin-based extensibility, integrated mailbox services (MoeMail/Laoudo/DuckMail), captcha solving (YesCaptcha/2Captcha/Camoufox), proxy pool management, and real-time log streaming via SSE to a web UI.

repos.description: Collaborator is a place to create with agents.
repos.summary_zh: Collaborator 是一款面向智能体开发的跨平台桌面应用，将终端、代码编辑器和上下文文件整合在无限画布中，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。基于 Electron 40、React 19 和 Tailwind CSS 4 构建，集成 Monaco 编辑器、xterm.js 终端和 D3 可视化，实现本地优先、无账号的协作开发环境，消除上下文切换，提升智能体协作效率。
repos.summary_en: Collaborator is a cross-platform desktop environment for agentic development, unifying terminals, code editors, and context files on an infinite canvas. Built with Electron 40, React 19, and Tailwind CSS 4, it integrates Monaco Editor, xterm.js terminal, and D3 visualization. Designed for local-first, account-free workflows, it eliminates context switching and enhances agent collaboration across macOS, Windows, and Linux.

repos.description: Consider it done. The open-source AI agent that works out of the box · 想到，就能做到。开源、开箱即用的 AI Agent。
repos.summary_zh: Cindy 是一款开源、开箱即用的跨平台 AI Agent 客户端，支持 Claude Code 和 Codex 等多种模型编排。它可在本地运行，集成文件系统访问、浏览器自动化和 MCP 协议，实现跨设备的任务编排与自动化执行。
repos.summary_en: Cindy is an open-source, out-of-the-box AI agent client supporting Claude Code and Codex orchestration. It runs locally with file system access, browser automation, and MCP protocol integration for cross-device task orchestration and automated execution.

repos.description: An unofficial 12306 Client for Mac
repos.summary_zh: 12306ForMac 是一款非官方的 Mac 版 12306 火车票订票助手，支持自动捡票与下单功能。基于 Swift 开发，依赖 Carthage 管理 CocoaPods 依赖，兼容 OS X 10.11 及以上系统。项目采用 Alamofire、PromiseKit 等主流框架，提供图形化界面替代官方网页购票，适用于 macOS 用户便捷购票。
repos.summary_en: 12306ForMac is an unofficial macOS client for 12306 railway ticket booking, supporting auto-search and purchasing. Built with Swift 3.2 and Xcode 9.0, it uses Carthage for dependency management and integrates Alamofire, PromiseKit, and FMDB. Designed for OS X 10.11+, it offers a native GUI alternative to the official web interface for convenient ticket booking.

repos.description: Collaborator is a place to create with agents.
repos.summary_zh: Collaborator 是一个专为 AI 智能体协作设计的 macOS 桌面应用，提供无限画布环境，集成终端、代码编辑器和文件管理功能。支持多工作区、实时终端交互和拖拽式文件操作，采用 Electron + React 技术栈，所有数据本地存储，适用于端到端的智能体开发流程。
repos.summary_en: Collaborator is a macOS-native desktop app for building with AI agents, featuring an infinite canvas workspace with integrated terminals, code editors, and file navigation. It supports multi-workspace management, real-time agent interaction, and local data storage, built on Electron, React, and xterm.js for seamless agentic development.

repos.description: 📺 Homebrew's official macOS GUI
repos.summary_zh: Homebrew官方macOS图形界面应用，采用SwiftUI构建，为不熟悉终端的用户提供直观的包管理体验。通过透明展示底层brew操作，实现软件包的安全发现、安装、更新与管理，适用于追求现代化原生体验的macOS开发者与普通用户。
repos.summary_en: Homebrew's official macOS GUI built with SwiftUI, offering an intuitive package management experience for users who prefer graphical interfaces over terminal. It transparently exposes underlying brew operations while enabling safe discovery, installation, and update of packages through a native macOS application.

repos.description: 开源免费的 Wispr Flow 替代方案 | 集成FunASR本地模型和可配置大语言模型的下一代中文桌面语音工作流
repos.summary_zh: 蛐蛐 (QuQu) 是一款开源免费的 Wispr Flow 替代方案，专为中文用户打造的桌面端智能语音工作流工具。集成阿里巴巴 FunASR 本地语音识别模型和可配置大语言模型，实现高精度中文识别与智能文本优化，支持隐私保护、国产 AI 模型适配及开发者友好功能，完全免费且跨平台。
repos.summary_en: QuQu is an open-source, free alternative to Wispr Flow, designed as a next-generation Chinese desktop voice workflow tool. It integrates Alibaba's FunASR local speech recognition model with configurable large language models, enabling high-precision Chinese transcription and intelligent text optimization. Features include privacy protection, support for domestic AI models, and developer-friendly formatting, all completely free and cross-platform.

repos.description: Elegant Microsoft To-Do desktop app
repos.summary_zh: Ao 是一款优雅的开源 Microsoft To-Do 桌面应用，支持深色/黑色/琥珀色主题、紧凑模式、全局快捷键、列表导航及跨平台使用，覆盖 120 余国用户，提供高度可定制界面与自动夜间模式，通过 GitHub Sponsors 获得社区支持。
repos.summary_en: Ao is an elegant, unofficial, open-source Microsoft To-Do desktop app used globally, featuring dark themes, compact mode, global shortcuts, list navigation, scalable UI, and auto-night mode, with community-driven development and support via GitHub Sponsors.

repos.description: 高颜值的第三方网易云播放器；通过自写插件可支持其他线上音乐服务；支持流媒体音乐，如navidrome、jellyfin、emby；支持本地音乐播放、离线歌单、逐字歌词、桌面歌词、Touch Bar歌词、Mac状态栏歌词显示、Linux-gnome与Linux-kde桌面状态栏歌词显示；支持降调降速，支持自定义主题等。支持 Windows / macOS / Linux :electron:
repos.summary_zh: VutronMusic 是一款高颜值跨平台第三方网易云音乐播放器，支持本地音乐、流媒体服务（如Navidrome、Jellyfin）、离线歌单及逐字歌词。具备桌面歌词、状态栏歌词、变调变速、自定义主题等功能，采用 Vue3 + TypeScript + Fastify 架构，支持 Windows/macOS/Linux 多平台。
repos.summary_en: VutronMusic is a high-end third-party NetEase Cloud Music player supporting local music, streaming services (Navidrome, Jellyfin), offline playlists, and karaoke-style lyrics. Features include desktop lyrics, system tray display, pitch/speed control, custom themes, and advanced audio effects. Built with Vue3, TypeScript, Fastify, and Electron for cross-platform support.

repos.description: Desktop Agent for Any Task
repos.summary_zh: WorkAny 是一款桌面 AI 智能体应用，通过自然语言指令执行复杂任务，支持实时代码生成、工具调用和沙箱环境运行。基于 Claude Agent SDK 构建，集成 MCP 协议与多模型供应商，提供文件管理、文档/网页/表格/幻灯片生成等全场景能力，适用于自动化办公与软件开发。
repos.summary_en: WorkAny is a desktop AI agent that executes tasks via natural language, featuring real-time code generation, sandboxed execution, and workspace management. Built on Claude Agent SDK with MCP support and multi-provider LLM integration, it enables automated file organization, document/web/table/slide generation, and software development workflows.

repos.description: Full-stack AI agent for coding, files, terminals, tools, research, content, multimodal work, and multi-agent workflows.
repos.summary_zh: ProxyCast 是一款基于 Tauri 的本地优先 AI Agent 创作工作台，整合 Workspace、Skills、MCP 标准能力与 Claw 渠道协作，实现从灵感到可发布内容的闭环流程。支持文档生成、研究整理、多平台异步协作及浏览器/终端扩展执行，适合创作者与知识工作者高效沉淀可复用资产。
repos.summary_en: ProxyCast is a local-first AI Agent workspace built with Tauri, integrating Workspace, Skills, MCP-standardized capabilities, and Claw channel collaboration to close the loop from idea to publishable content. It supports document generation, research organization, cross-platform async workflows, and browser/terminal extensions, ideal for creators and knowledge workers to streamline reusable output.

repos.summary_zh: Any Code 是一款专业的 AI 代码助手桌面应用，基于 Tauri 框架构建，支持 Claude Code、OpenAI Codex 和 Google Gemini 三大 AI 引擎。提供统一会话管理、智能成本追踪、MCP 扩展集成、Hooks 自动化等核心功能，具备多项目并行处理、实时流式输出、Token 优化及开发者友好工具链，适用于高效 AI 辅助开发场景。
repos.summary_en: Any Code is a professional AI-powered code assistant desktop application built with Tauri, supporting three major AI engines: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and Google Gemini. It offers unified session management, intelligent cost tracking, MCP extension integration, Hooks automation, multi-project parallel processing, real-time streaming output, token optimization, and developer-friendly tooling for efficient AI-assisted development.

repos.description: A dev environment for AI agents.
repos.summary_zh: Jean 是一款基于 Tauri v2 的桌面 AI 助手应用，专为多项目管理、git worktree 自动化及 Claude/Codex/OpenCode CLI 集成设计。支持会话管理、AI 编程助手（含思维链与 MCP 支持）、GitHub 问题追踪、终端集成及远程 Web 访问，提供本地化的无厂商锁定开发体验。
repos.summary_en: Jean is a desktop AI assistant built with Tauri v2, designed for managing multiple projects, git worktrees, and integrating Claude CLI, Codex CLI, and OpenCode. It offers session management, AI-powered development workflows (with thinking modes and MCP support), GitHub integration, terminal access, and remote web access—all running locally without vendor lock-in.

repos.description: A free and open-source collection of native macOS menu bar tools.
repos.summary_zh: MacTools 是一款基于 SwiftUI 和 AppKit 开发的免费开源 macOS 菜单栏工具集，专为 macOS 14.0+ 设计。它集成了显示器亮度调节、分辨率切换、深色模式、夜览、防睡眠、鼠标增强、隐藏刘海、磁盘清理及 Xcode 缓存清理等数十项高频系统操作，旨在通过轻量、无干扰的原生应用提升 Mac 用户的工作效率与系统管理能力。
repos.summary_en: MacTools is a free, open-source collection of native macOS menu bar utilities built with SwiftUI and AppKit for macOS 14.0+. It consolidates dozens of high-frequency system actions—including display brightness/resolution control, Dark Mode, Night Shift, sleep prevention, mouse enhancement, notch hiding, disk cleanup, and Xcode cache management—into a lightweight, unobtrusive app to boost productivity and system control.

repos.description: Develop desktop apps with a web frontend or native UI in Go
repos.summary_zh: 用Go开发桌面应用，支持WebView网页前端或纯Go原生UI，混合使用。纯Go无cgo跨平台，类型化IPC，内置Flexbox/Grid布局、动画等UI工具包，自带完整打包分发能力，单二进制仅数MB，低内存CPU占用。
repos.summary_en: Build desktop apps in Go with web or native UI. Pure Go, no cgo, cross-platform. Typed IPC with generated TypeScript client. Built-in UI toolkit (flexbox/grid, animations). Complete bundling & distribution. Single binary, low memory/CPU footprint.

repos.description: ✨ AI Gist 是一款隐私优先的 AI 提示词管理工具，致力于让个人收藏的 AI 提示词能够发挥最大价值。支持变量替换、Jinja 模板、AI 生成与调优、历史版本记录、云端备份等核心功能。
repos.summary_zh: AI Gist 是一款隐私优先的 AI 提示词管理工具，支持 Jinja 模板与变量动态替换，集成多种 AI 模型实现自动生成与调优提示词。所有数据本地存储，支持 WebDAV/iCloud 云端备份，跨 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android、iOS 多平台运行，帮助用户高效收藏与管理个人提示词资产。
repos.summary_en: AI Gist is a privacy-first AI prompt management tool featuring Jinja template support and dynamic variable substitution. It integrates multiple AI models for auto-generating and optimizing prompts, with all data stored locally. Cloud backup via WebDAV/iCloud is supported. Cross-platform for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS, it helps users efficiently collect and manage personal prompt assets.

repos.description: AI-powered desktop SQL client. Cross-platform. Built with Flutter.
repos.summary_zh: openhare 是一款基于 Flutter 开发的跨平台 AI 驱动桌面 SQL 客户端，支持 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQL Server、SQLite 和 Oracle 等多种数据库。其核心亮点在于集成 AI 辅助功能，可智能生成、优化和理解 SQL 查询语句，显著提升开发者和 DBA 的工作效率。
repos.summary_en: Openhare is an AI-powered, cross-platform desktop SQL client built with Flutter, supporting multiple databases including MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, SQLite, and Oracle. Its standout feature is integrated AI assistance for generating, optimizing, and interpreting SQL queries, enhancing productivity for developers and DBAs.

repos.description: A calm menu bar, done the native way. Hides the icons you don't need until you do.
repos.summary_zh: Pelmet 是一款原生 macOS 菜单栏管理工具，专为 macOS 27 重新设计的菜单栏打造。它可将不常用图标自动隐藏，通过悬停、点击或快捷键优雅恢复显示，支持可视化布局编辑器与三区域分组管理，免费开源无账号要求。
repos.summary_en: Pelmet is an open-source macOS menu bar manager designed for the redesigned menu bar in macOS 27. It auto-hides unused icons and elegantly reveals them via hover, click, or shortcuts, featuring a visual layout editor with three-zone grouping. Free, native, no account needed.

repos.description: Master your Mac’s ⌘Tab
repos.summary_zh: BetterCmdTab 是一款专为 macOS 设计的 ⌘+Tab 应用切换器增强工具，提供列表、网格和实时预览三种布局，支持模糊搜索、窗口平铺、标签页切换及多显示器操作。采用原生 SwiftUI 开发，具备 Liquid Glass 视觉效果，无遥测且完全免费，极大提升 Mac 用户的窗口管理效率。
repos.summary_en: BetterCmdTab enhances the macOS ⌘+Tab experience with three layouts (list, grid, live preview), fuzzy search, window tiling, and tab switching. Built natively with SwiftUI featuring Liquid Glass aesthetics, it offers zero telemetry and is free forever, significantly boosting window management efficiency for Mac users.

repos.description: Open-source cross-platform software KVM for sharing keyboard, mouse, and clipboard across Windows, macOS, and Linux on trusted LANs.
repos.summary_zh: MyKVM 是一款开源的跨平台软件 KVM 解决方案，允许用户通过局域网在 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 设备间无缝共享键盘、鼠标和剪贴板。它利用 QUIC/TLS 加密传输输入与剪贴板数据，支持自动发现与多显示器布局，旨在替代传统硬件 KVM 切换器，为多机工作者提供零线缆的流畅体验。
repos.summary_en: MyKVM is an open-source, cross-platform software KVM that enables seamless sharing of keyboard, mouse, and clipboard across Windows, macOS, and Linux devices over a trusted LAN. Utilizing encrypted QUIC/TLS for input and clipboard data transfer, it features automatic peer discovery and multi-monitor layout support, aiming to replace traditional hardware KVM switches with a zero-cable experience for multi-machine workflows.

repos.description: A minimal modern terminal for AI coding experience — Sidebar workspaces; horizontal / vertical split panes; one-click agent launch; per-agent activity readout; live workspace state with one-click Node and branch switching.
repos.summary_zh: kooky 是一款专为 AI 编码打造的现代化 macOS 终端模拟器，基于 libghostty 实现 GPU 渲染。核心特性包括侧边栏工作区、多窗格分屏、一键启动 Claude Code/Gemini CLI 等多种 AI Agent、Git Worktree 隔离开发、右键选中内容直接询问 Agent、模糊快速打开面板以及多行提示词编辑器。支持会话自动恢复、跨窗口拖拽标签页，无账号无遥测，状态完全本地存储。
repos.summary_en: kooky is a minimal modern terminal emulator built for AI coding on macOS, powered by libghostty with GPU rendering. Key features include sidebar workspaces, horizontal/vertical split panes, one-click launch of Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, and other AI agents, Git Worktree isolation, right-click-to-ask-agent on selections, fuzzy Quick Open panel, and a multi-line prompt composer. Sessions auto-resume across restarts, tabs are draggable across panes and windows, and all state stays local with no accounts or telemetry.

repos.description: Beautiful native macOS download manager for direct links, magnets, and torrents.
repos.summary_zh: Harbor是一款原生macOS下载管理器，基于SwiftUI构建，支持直链、磁力链接与种子文件下载。主打本地优先、隐私友好设计，提供批量添加、流量控制、Torrent预览等实用功能，完美契合Mac原生工作流。
repos.summary_en: Harbor is a beautiful native macOS download manager built with SwiftUI, supporting direct links, magnet links, and torrents. Local-first, privacy-friendly, and free, it offers batch queuing, traffic profiles, and Torrent preview for a seamless Mac-native experience.

repos.description: Create stunning screen recordings for free. Open-source, no subscriptions, no watermarks, and free for commercial use. An alternative to Screen Studio.
repos.summary_zh: CursorLens 是一款免费开源的屏幕录制与编辑工具，专为创作者、开发者和团队设计。基于 OpenScreen 构建，深度优化 macOS 原生捕获流程，支持全屏/窗口录制、摄像头画中画、语音录制、时间轴剪辑、字幕生成及多比例导出，无水印且商用免费。
repos.summary_en: CursorLens is a free, open-source screen recorder and editor built on OpenScreen, enhanced for native macOS capture and editing. It supports full-screen/app recording, camera overlay, voice input, timeline editing, subtitle generation, and multi-aspect export—all watermark-free and commercially usable.

repos.description: A fast, native RSS reader — plus an agent-facing CLI so your AI agent can read, search and triage your feeds from the shell.
repos.summary_zh: Papr 是一款专为桌面端设计的快速原生 RSS 阅读器，支持订阅管理、智能分类、全文抓取、AI 摘要与问答、音频播放及 FreshRSS 同步，数据本地存储于 SQLite，无云端依赖，提供多语言界面。
repos.summary_en: Papr is a fast, native desktop RSS reader featuring feed organization, smart views, full-text fetching, AI-powered summaries and Q&A, audio playback, FreshRSS sync, and local-first data storage via SQLite—no cloud or account required.

repos.description: Pi — A cross-platform AI coding agent, bringing the Claude Code experience to your desktop. No environment setup, no terminal commands. Download and start coding right away.
repos.summary_zh: Pi Agent 是一款跨平台 AI 编码代理桌面应用，将 Claude Code 能力封装为免配置的一体化安装包。支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux，无需终端命令即可直接与 AI 助手协作编程。提供会话管理、模型配置、代码预览和自动更新等功能。
repos.summary_en: Pi Agent is a cross-platform AI coding agent desktop app that packages Claude Code capabilities into a standalone, zero-config application. Supporting macOS, Windows, and Linux, it enables seamless AI-assisted development without terminal commands. Features include session management, model configuration, code preview, and automatic updates.

repos.description: 📁 轻盈优雅的 Web 原生 Cloudflare R2 桶文件管理器，一切皆在浏览器中完成。 | 📁 A lightweight, elegant, pure-browser Cloudflare R2 file manager. Everything happens right in your browser.
repos.summary_zh: R2 Web 是一款轻量级、优雅的纯浏览器 Cloudflare R2 文件管理器，无需构建或后端服务。它支持拖拽上传、图片压缩、多语言界面、深色模式及 PWA 桌面安装，所有操作均在客户端完成，直连 R2 API，保障数据安全。
repos.summary_en: R2 Web is a lightweight, elegant, pure-browser file manager for Cloudflare R2, with no build step or backend required. It supports drag-and-drop uploads, image compression, multi-language UI, dark mode, and PWA desktop installation—all client-side operations directly connecting to the R2 API.

repos.description: Browser-Use Desktop app, control your local Chrome browser with AI agents!
repos.summary_zh: Browser-Use Desktop 是一款基于 Electron 和 Gradio 的桌面应用，通过 AI 智能体控制本地 Chrome 浏览器，实现网页自动化操作。支持多模态 LLM（如 OpenAI、Google、Anthropic 等）和自定义浏览器配置，无需重新登录网站，支持高清屏幕录制，适用于网页抓取、自动化测试等场景。
repos.summary_en: Browser-Use Desktop is an Electron-based desktop app that enables AI agents to control your local Chrome browser via Gradio UI. It supports multiple LLMs (OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, etc.), custom browser profiles, and high-definition screen recording, eliminating re-authentication issues and ideal for web automation and scraping tasks.

repos.description: Agent Skills for theming AI desktop apps: reference image → reversible Codex/WorkBuddy skin → verify, repair, publish. | 给 AI 桌面应用换肤的 Agent Skills：参考图 → 可逆皮肤 → 验证、修复、发布。
repos.summary_zh: CodeDrobe Skills 是一个开源的 AI 桌面应用主题生成与管理系统，专为 OpenAI Codex 和腾讯 WorkBuddy 等基于 Chromium/Electron 的 AI 桌面端提供可逆的主题定制方案。它通过 AI 技能（Skill）驱动，支持 DOM 快照分析、语义化主题生成与跨平台应用，极大简化了 AI 桌面环境的个性化与视觉管理。
repos.summary_en: CodeDrobe Skills is an open-source AI-driven theming engine for Chromium/Electron-based AI desktop apps like OpenAI Codex and Tencent WorkBuddy. It provides a reversible theme customization workflow utilizing DOM snapshot analysis and semantic generation. Managed via installable Agent Skills, it simplifies visual personalization and cross-platform theme deployment for AI desktop environments.

repos.description: Local-first dashboard for observing Claude Code usage, cost, sessions, and time.
repos.summary_zh: Lumo是一款本地优先的桌面应用，专为开发者设计，用于追踪Claude Code的使用情况。它通过本地SQLite数据库收集并可视化成本、令牌消耗、会话时长和编码时间等关键指标，提供直观的仪表盘视图，无需云端账户或数据外传，完全在用户机器上运行。
repos.summary_en: Lumo is a local-first desktop application that tracks Claude Code usage by collecting telemetry data locally. It provides real-time dashboards for cost, tokens, sessions, and coding time using a native Tauri + Next.js UI, storing everything in a local SQLite database without requiring cloud accounts or external data transmission.

repos.description: Local-first desktop API client built for developers and AI agents
repos.summary_zh: Voleeo 是一款面向 AI 时代的本地优先桌面 API 客户端，原生支持 HTTP、gRPC、WebSocket 和 GraphQL 四大协议。内置 MCP Server，允许 AI 智能体直接读写工作区、发起请求与管理环境。具备 AES-256-GCM 加密、OAuth 2.0 等全链路认证、Git 版本控制、OpenAPI/Postman 导入及插件扩展能力，零遥测、无云端锁定。
repos.summary_en: Voleeo is a local-first desktop API client built for the AI era, natively supporting HTTP, gRPC, WebSocket, and GraphQL in a single app. It doubles as an MCP server, enabling AI agents to read, create, and execute requests directly from chat. Features include AES-256-GCM encryption, full auth suites (OAuth 2.0, SigV4, etc.), Git-based collection versioning, OpenAPI/Postman imports, plugin extensibility, and zero telemetry with no cloud lock-in.

repos.description: 一个监控股票的工具
repos.summary_zh: iNeedMyMoneyBack 是一款面向个人投资者的桌面端股票监控工具，支持 A 股、港股、美股及指数的实时行情展示。用户可自定义监控列表、显示字段与刷新频率，并在价格达到目标值时接收系统通知。界面支持表格与滚动模式、全局快捷键、双击跳转行情网站，并内置自动更新组件，适合需要持续关注持仓与大盘动态的股民使用。
repos.summary_en: iNeedMyMoneyBack is a desktop stock monitoring tool for individual investors, providing real-time quotes for A-shares, HK, US stocks, and major indices. Users can customize watchlists, display fields, and refresh intervals, and receive system notifications when target prices are reached. The app supports table and scroll views, global shortcuts, double-click navigation to financial sites, and includes an auto-update component, making it ideal for tracking portfolios and market movements.

repos.description: A local macOS desktop matting tool built with Tauri, Vue, and Rust.
repos.summary_zh: Apple Matting 是一款基于 Tauri、Vue 和 Rust 开发的本地 macOS 桌面背景抠图工具，支持单张及批量图片处理，兼容 JPG/PNG/WEBP/BMP 格式，提供实时预览、透明/纯色/渐变背景替换及编辑修正功能，集成中文/英文双语界面。
repos.summary_en: Apple Matting is a local macOS desktop background removal tool built with Tauri, Vue, and Rust. It supports single and batch image processing, offers real-time preview, transparent/solid-color/gradient backgrounds, and includes a bilingual UI (Chinese/English) with editing refinements.

repos.description: Your desktop AI agent, always ready
repos.summary_zh: TouchAI 是一款桌面端 AI 智能体工具，通过快捷键 Alt+Space 快速唤起，支持全键盘操作，不打断用户工作流。它能智能感知桌面上下文（文件、屏幕、剪贴板），内置 7 大工具并支持 MCP 协议扩展，采用 BYOK 模式允许用户自由切换 AI 提供商和模型，无厂商锁定。支持文件搜索、可视化交互界面及模型自升级功能，是提升桌面办公效率的 AI 自动化工具。
repos.summary_en: TouchAI is a desktop AI agent that can be instantly summoned via Alt+Space hotkey without interrupting workflow. It supports full keyboard operation and intelligently perceives desktop context including files, screen, and clipboard. With 7 built-in tools and MCP protocol extensibility, it adopts a BYOK model allowing users to freely switch between AI providers and models without vendor lock-in. Features include file search, visual interactive UI, and model self-upgrade.

repos.description: 一款跨平台智能笔记 Agent 应用，支持多格式笔记、本地知识库、AI 智能助手、向量语义检索 。
repos.summary_zh: OpenNote 是一款跨平台智能笔记 Agent 应用，支持多格式笔记管理、本地知识库构建、AI 智能助手及向量语义检索。具备长期记忆与自我进化能力，通过 MCP 协议与 AI 大模型深度集成，实现知识的高效组织与智能问答，适合个人知识管理与 AI 增强型笔记场景。
repos.summary_en: OpenNote is a cross-platform intelligent note-taking Agent application that supports multi-format note management, local knowledge base building, AI-powered assistance, and vector semantic search. With long-term memory and self-evolving capabilities, it integrates deeply with AI large language models via the MCP protocol, enabling efficient knowledge organization and intelligent Q&A for personal knowledge management and AI-enhanced note-taking scenarios.

repos.description: Cross-platform desktop wrapper for TUIStudio (Wails v2 + Go) http://tui.studio
repos.summary_zh: TUIStudio Desktop 是基于 Wails v2（Go + WebView）构建的跨平台桌面应用，为 TUIStudio 提供原生 GUI 支持。支持 macOS (.dmg)、Windows (.exe) 和 Linux (.deb) 多平台发布，体积小巧（约8MB），通过 Go 与前端 Vite 热重载集成实现高效开发流程，适用于 TUI 界面可视化设计场景。
repos.summary_en: TUIStudio Desktop is a cross-platform desktop wrapper for TUIStudio, built with Wails v2 (Go + WebView). It packages as lightweight installers: .dmg (~8 MB), NSIS .exe, and .deb. Features hot-reload dev workflow via Vite and Go IPC bridge, enabling native file dialogs and seamless integration for TUI design tools.

repos.description: A lightweight, context-aware AI assistant designed specifically for macOS
repos.summary_zh: Sidey 是一款专为 macOS 打造的轻量级、上下文感知 AI 助手。它以菜单栏弹出窗口和悬浮窗伴侣形式快速调用，支持选中文本即时处理、应用感知提示词推荐、多应用专属 AI 人格自动创建，并深度集成 Safari 与 Finder。内置公共 AI 服务无需 API Key，支持 Markdown 渲染、iCloud 同步与全局热键，实现无缝跨应用智能辅助。
repos.summary_en: Sidey is a lightweight, context-aware AI assistant built exclusively for macOS. It launches instantly from the menu bar or as a window-docked companion, offering selection-based text processing, app-aware prompt suggestions, and auto-generated AI personas per application. With deep Safari and Finder integration, built-in public AI service, Markdown rendering, iCloud sync, and global hotkeys, Sidey delivers seamless cross-app intelligent assistance without disrupting your workflow.
